changelog: Lyrics now load when you switch tracks instead of showing "unavailable"
Lyrics now prefer the studio recording over live, karaoke and cover versions
Synced lyrics now respect offset tags instead of drifting from the audio
Lyrics now support multiple timestamps per line and 1-3 digit fractions
The lyrics view now opens at the current line and follows the song while paused
Synced lyrics now highlight within 250 ms of the audio
Failed lyrics lookups now retry instead of staying empty for the session
